2609.26426.title: DeepFEAv2: Deep Learning for Transient Finite Element Analysis Beyond Structured Meshes
2609.26426.paper_summary: Finite Element Analysis (FEA) is widely used for transient mechanical simulations, but its high computational cost limits real-time and high-resolution applications. Deep learning surrogate models can reduce this cost; however, many existing approaches are restricted to steady-state prediction or cannot jointly predict Node- and Element-based Outputs (NEO) over time. The state-of-the-art DeepFEA framework has addressed these issues but remains limited to structured finite element (FE) meshes. To overcome this limitation, this study proposes DeepFEAv2, a deep learning surrogate framework that enables prediction of transient FEA simulations across different FE mesh topologies and element types. The main contributions of DeepFEAv2 are: (a) a module that uses the FE connectivity matrix to organize input features by element and arrange them into an input sequence guided by the mesh topology; (b) a novel neural network architecture designed to process the input sequence and jointly predict NEO over time; and (c) a FEA-informed optimization strategy for regularizing these NEO predictions. DeepFEAv2 was evaluated on structured and unstructured 3D linear elastic datasets, as well as on a pressure-driven aortic valve dataset. DeepFEAv2 achieved R^2 values up to 0.99 and normalized errors as low as 0.38%. Compared with DeepFEA, it achieved up to 38.0% relative increase in R^2 and up to 87.1% reduction in normalized error. DeepFEAv2 also performed inference up to three orders of magnitude faster than traditional FEA. These results demonstrate that DeepFEAv2 can efficiently model transient FEA simulations across increasingly complex FE settings, providing a scalable surrogate framework for transient FEA.
2609.26426.paper_summary_zh: 有限元素分析（FEA）廣泛應用於瞬態機械模擬，但其高計算成本限制了實時和高解析度的應用。深度學習替代模型可以降低這一成本；然而，許多現有方法僅限於穩態預測，或無法隨時間共同預測基於節點和元素的輸出（NEO）。最先進的DeepFEA框架已經解決了這些問題，但仍然限於結構化的有限元素（FE）網格。為了克服這一限制，本研究提出了DeepFEAv2，一個深度學習替代框架，能夠在不同的FE網格拓撲和元素類型之間預測瞬態FEA模擬。DeepFEAv2的主要貢獻包括：（a）一個模組，利用FE連接矩陣按元素組織輸入特徵，並根據網格拓撲將其排列成輸入序列；（b）一種新穎的神經網絡架構，旨在處理輸入序列並隨時間共同預測NEO；以及（c）一種基於FEA的優化策略，用於正則化這些NEO預測。DeepFEAv2在結構化和非結構化的3D線性彈性數據集，以及在壓力驅動的主動脈瓣數據集上進行了評估。DeepFEAv2達到了高達0.99的R^2值，並且標準化誤差低至0.38%。與DeepFEA相比，它在R^2上實現了高達38.0%的相對增長，並在標準化誤差上實現了高達87.1%的減少。DeepFEAv2的推斷速度也比傳統FEA快了三個數量級。這些結果表明，DeepFEAv2能夠高效地建模越來越複雜的FE設置中的瞬態FEA模擬，為瞬態FEA提供了一個可擴展的替代框架。
